contents_index.core_default_declarations: Gate/ER operating declarations mirrored from the live core defaults (docs/PACK_DESIGN.md §3: RUN class, defaults CORE-pinned): triple_threshold 0.25, review_band 0.25-0.50, er_threshold 0.40, er_cross_doc_min_p_same 0.85 (the cross-document merge guard, deliberately not per-domain), batch_cost_cap_usd 10.0, er_auto_merge form_variants_only, er_alias_sources text_attested_only, chunk_window_chars 1000 / chunk_min_chars 100. Declarations, not live values — BatchConfig governs the run.
contents_index.enumeration_operating_point: The enumeration decision (2026-10-21): pair_window 'adjacent' (max_dist=1) as the baseline window default when a run or pack selects pair enumeration; REC (deterministic roster surface recovery) is core mechanism and has no setup_config key. The baseline does not force pair_enumeration on — a pack that omits the switch keeps the core free-proposal path, and a pack declaring its own pair_window overrides this default.
contents_index.neutral_framing: The neutral core framing (post domain-boundary fix) carried as data: proposer_framing, slot_framing, slot_rules — byte-equal to pipeline/proposer.py's TRIPLE_FRAMING_DEFAULT / SLOT_FRAMING_DEFAULT / SLOT_RULES_DEFAULT. No domain framing text anywhere in the payload.
contents_index.no_domain_content: Deliberately absent: schema_front, entity_types / relation_types, label_categories, merge_prohibited_type_pairs, role_word_rules_from_profile, c1_whitelist, relation_map, corpus_scope, fitted artefacts, candidates. A specified domain pack supplies any of these as data and overrides this baseline per key (resolution, pipeline.profile_config.resolve_setup_config).
contents_index.pair_judge: F1 baseline variant declarations: pair_judge_context 'sentence' x pair_judge_instruction 'standard'. The JF-F1 direction slot is an adopted core mechanism (conformance GC-3) activated only by a domain pack's pair_judge_format declaration plus its pinned symmetric-set artefact; the core pack owns no inventory and declares neither — 'jf1' without the source fails validation, fail-closed.
contents_index.reference_profile: No model names, endpoints, or secrets in this pack (the three-layer rule). The tested bindings ship as the connection layer's default preset (pipeline/reference_profile.py; the reference-profile decision); the Jev gate is a pinned product component, and the threshold declarations above were calibrated under it (conformance GC-1 / GC-5).

convention_notes.note: Resolution: this pack is the baseline layer. resolve_setup_config(root) returns this payload alone; resolve_setup_config(root, pack_dir) overlays the specified pack's payload per key — keys the specified pack declares govern, undeclared keys keep these defaults. There is no degraded fallback: a specified pack that fails its pin or validation refuses the whole resolution.

Renamed pre-release (2026-10-22): pack id 'general' / display 'General' -> 'core' / 'Core'. The baseline is a layer under every domain pack, not a domain of its own; the old name collided with the 'General Documents' domain pack (itself renamed 'Open Domain'). Identity fields and the payload's family / pack_id stamps were updated and the version bumped per §1.2; no operating content changed.

payload.note: In force. The domain-neutral baseline payload assembled in Phase A2: core default declarations + neutral framing + the D5 window default, and no domain content. There is no lab payload to bind — the core pack is absent from the lab record by design (the pre-pack default is core-only, with no artefact); these bytes are authored from the live core defaults (pipeline/batch.py BatchConfig, pipeline/batch_run.py ER_XDOC_MERGE_MIN, pipeline/proposer.py framing constants) and pinned here when the pack was assembled as 0.1.0 (the current version is the pack_version field above). Any change is a version bump, never an in-place edit (§1.2).

scope: Undifferentiated data — the domain-neutral default a new user starts with; not validated on a single dataset (its conformance record is the cross-domain core record).
